نتقاعس (form VI)
# نَتَقَاعَسُ (nataqāʕasu) /na.ta.qaː.ʕa.su/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَقَاعَسَ (taqāʕasa)
# نَتَقَاعَسَ (nataqāʕasa) /na.ta.qaː.ʕa.sa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَقَاعَسَ (taqāʕasa)
# نَتَقَاعَسْ (nataqāʕas) /na.ta.qaː.ʕas/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَقَاعَسَ (taqāʕasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
